description: Synthetic redacted illustrative constraints only: six pairs share identical evidence catalogs while explicit request context or as_of changes the expected reviewed labels. Audience permissions are stipulated fixture inputs: owner may receive details; authorized collaborator may receive the shared summary only. The unrelated-task case requests supported project memory for an unrelated task and requires memory abstention, not silence in general conversation; the ordinary unrelated task can still be answered normally. An active revocation audit describes a historical event; it does not reactivate the superseded plan. History is optional for current action and required for retrospective. status_tentative_inference is a reviewed label for an explicitly attributed unverified inference; confidence=supported supports that attribution, not the underlying proposition. Only syn_external_check supports status_verified_fact after its validity begins; prior_inference_history may preserve the earlier attribution without restoring a tentative current status. The companion candidate is a hand-authored synthetic_reference scorer oracle only. All context_tokens and latency_ms values are unmeasured placeholders (0), not zero-cost execution or optimization or benchmark results. Existing scorer validates label/evidence obligations only; natural-language semantics, retrieval scope, actual access control, learning, and runtime behavior are not evaluated.
